segments.name: Golf equipment
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells performance golf equipment, including premium golf shafts and putters, for golfers and club fitters.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized and operates as one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Golfers, club fitters, resellers, distributors and golf retailers pay for the company's golf shafts, putters and other golf equipment, bought directly online or through intermediaries.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells its products through a combination of direct-to-consumer channels, including its websites, as well as through resellers, professional club fitters, distributors, and golf retailers.
